participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Cynical and straightforward, prefers clear communication and can be dismissive of perceived oddness.
participant_1.background: Alex has a background in graphic design and enjoys attending social events, but is selective about whom to engage with.

participant_2.name: Jordan
participant_2.personality: Outgoing and playful, loves to socialize and has a whimsical view on life, often expressed through humor.
participant_2.background: Jordan is a party planner with a passion for events and animals, particularly dogs, and enjoys sharing stories and making connections.
